pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What number is "drei"? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 12
   C. 0
   D. 3

2. Which verb form completes "Der Hund ___ im Garten"? (schlafen) (1 mark)
   A. schlaft
   B. schläft
   C. schlafen
   D. schlafe

3. What does "das Kind" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. child
   B. brother
   C. uncle
   D. father

4. Which little word goes with the noun "Mango"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

5. How is the letter D named in German? (1 mark)
   A. kah
   B. tay
   C. yot
   D. day

6. Which phrase is correct for "in the kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. in die Küche
   B. in dem Küche
   C. in der Küche
   D. im Küche

7. Which food group does "das Wasser" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. das Gemüse
   C. das Obst
   D. die Getränke

8. What does "das Bett" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. sofa
   C. bed
   D. door

9. Which German word is the number 5? (1 mark)
   A. fünf
   B. elf
   C. siebzehn
   D. vierzehn

10. What does "hinter der Tür" mean? (1 mark)
   A. in front of the door
   B. behind the door
   C. next to the door
   D. on the door

11. What is the plural of "das Bein"? (1 mark)
   A. die Beins
   B. die Beiner
   C. die Beine
   D. die Beinen

12. Which verb do you use with "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. kochen
   B. essen
   C. trinken
   D. schlafen

13. Which German word or phrase means "thunderstorm"? (1 mark)
   A. die Wolke
   B. der Regenbogen
   C. das Wetter
   D. das Gewitter

14. Which birthday wish means "All the best for your birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Appetit!
   B. Gute Nacht!
   C. Auf Wiedersehen!
   D. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!

15. Which verb form completes "Mutter ___ in der Küche"? (kochen) (1 mark)
   A. kochen
   B. kochst
   C. koche
   D. kocht

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the German words with der, die or das for: hand, bread, maize. (3 marks)

17. Write the German words with der, die or das for: garden, room, sun, thunderstorm. (4 marks)

18. Write the German words with der, die or das for: spoon, supper. (2 marks)

19. Write the numbers 3, 9 and 12 in German. (3 marks)

20. Write a menu for one day in German with three meals. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 3
   drei is the number 3.

2. B — schläft
   schlafen changes to schläft for er, sie and es.

3. A — child
   das Kind means child.

4. A — die
   It is die Mango, so the little word is die.

5. D — day
   In German the letter D is called day.

6. C — in der Küche
   Küche is a die word.

7. D — die Getränke
   das Wasser belongs to die Getränke.

8. C — bed
   das Bett means bed.

9. A — fünf
   5 in German is fünf.

10. B — behind the door
   hinter means behind.

11. C — die Beine
   The plural of das Bein is die Beine.

12. C — trinken
   We drink water.

13. D — das Gewitter
   thunderstorm in German is das Gewitter.

14. D — Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Alles Gute zum Geburtstag is the usual birthday wish.

15. D — kocht
   With Mutter (she) the verb ends in -t.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Hand, das Brot, der Mais.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Garten, das Zimmer, die Sonne, das Gewitter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Löffel, das Abendessen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Frühstück: Tee und Brot. Mittagessen: Reis und Bohnen. Abendessen: Ugali und Fisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meal correctly written.
